svg.title: Engineering pulse — real project commits
svg.desc: 980 commits across five public projects, 70 active days, peak 114 commits per day. 2026-08-18 through 2026-11-09 UTC. Each column represents one day; height is proportional to commit count. All authors, default branches, merge commits included. Snapshot 2026-11-09T02:23:12.075Z.
